name: prophet-rev2
description:
prophet-rev2.tap: an eight-voice synth after the Sequential Prophet Rev2.

Each voice is two DCOs (saw, triangle, saw+triangle, pulse) with hard sync,
a sub-octave square and noise into a Curtis low-pass, then a VCA; a filter
envelope, an amp envelope and an LFO modulate them.  Voices are spread
across the stereo field.

The filter is the part of the Rev2 that is analog.  Its PA397 chip is a
descendant of the Curtis CEM3397: four OTA integrator stages in a row with
a feedback path for resonance, switchable between two and four poles.
`ota_lowpass` in kit.tap models that; here it is driven hard enough that a
full mixer saturates the first stage, and, as on the Rev2, the four-pole
mode self-oscillates at full resonance while the two-pole mode cannot.

Play it with `note_on` and `note_off` (a music_note; pitch is a MIDI note
number, velocity 0..1).  One note-on and one note-off per block.

Not modelled: the aux envelope, LFOs 2-4 and the modulation matrix, unison,
the second layer, the sequencers, the arpeggiator and the effects.
